# LeadWeave

> Open Source WhatsApp API Gateway & Management Dashboard

LeadWeave provides an open-source WhatsApp gateway, messaging automation, and dashboard management interface.

## Quick Links
- [Dashboard](http://localhost:2886/): Main web UI
- [Chats](http://localhost:2886/chats): Real-time chat management
- [Sessions](http://localhost:2886/sessions): WhatsApp sessions and pairing
- [Webhooks](http://localhost:2886/webhooks): Event subscriptions and webhook configuration
- [Templates](http://localhost:2886/templates): WhatsApp message templates
